children: Klarna, the everyday finance network, today announced its participation in the following investor conference in December.
UBS Global Technology and AI Conference (David Sykes, President and Chief Commercial Officer)
Live webcasts and archived replays will be available on Klarna’s investor relations website at investors.klarna.com.

Klarna is the everyday finance network. With over 120 million global active Klarna users and 3.8 million transactions per day, Klarna’s AI-powered payments and commerce network is empowering people to pay smarter with a mission to be available everywhere for everything. Consumers can pay with Klarna online, in-store and through Apple Pay & Google Pay. Over 1.2 million retailers trust Klarna’s innovative solutions to drive growth and loyalty, including Uber, H&M, Saks, Sephora, Macy’s, Ikea, Expedia Group, Nike and Airbnb.
